triggers.name: bot_command
triggers.title: New command
triggers.description: New command from Workbot for Microsoft Teams
triggers.help: Fetches trigger events as soon as they occur.

input.name: name
input.label: Command
input.hint: Command name. Use standard name or create your own. E.g. Add, Show, List. No spaces allowed

input.name: domain
input.label: Application
input.hint: Application associated with the command. Use standard name or create your own. E.g. Zendesk, Xero. No spaces allowed

input.name: scope
input.label: Document
input.hint: Document associated with the command. Use standard name or create your own. E.g. Customer, Ticket, Lead. No spaces allowed

input.name: description
input.label: Hint
input.hint: Displayed as help in Microsoft Teams. E.g. Show customer details

input.name: parameters
input.label: Command input
input.hint: Commands can take input parameters. The format for specifying input is parameter name [optional:true] [type:string or date_time] [hint:help] [sample:John] E.g. customer_id hint:customer ID sample:1278…

actions.name: post_bot_notification
actions.title: Post notification
actions.description: Post notification to Workbot for Microsoft Teams

input.name: event
input.label: Name
input.hint: Event name. Use standard name or create your own. E.g. Added, Updated. No spaces allowed

input.name: domain
input.label: Application
input.hint: Application associated with the event. Use standard name or create your own. E.g. Zendesk, Xero. No spaces allowed

input.name: scope
input.label: Document
input.hint: Document associated with the event. Use standard name or create your own. E.g. Customer, Ticket, Lead. No spaces allowed

input.name: title
input.label: Title
input.hint: Title as seen in Microsoft Teams message.

input.name: title_link
input.label: Title link
input.hint: Titles can be clickable. Provide URL of page to view on click

input.name: attachment_text
input.label: Description
input.hint: Detailed message

input.name: color
input.label: Message type
input.hint: Messages can be displayed in different styles based on type.

input.name: attachment_fields
input.label: Fields
input.hint: Fields to display in a grid. One name-value pair per line. E.g.: Name:John

input.name: context
input.label: Related documents
input.hint: Commands can be linked to other commands via the document they operate on. Workbot uses this to recommend commands in a conversation. Specify links using this format document name identifier_1:"App da…

input.name: filters_schema
input.label: Notification filters
input.hint: Notificaton support filters. The format for specifying filter is parameter name [optional:true] [type:string or date_time] [hint:help] [sample:John] E.g. start hint:Opportunity state, e.g. Closed Won,…
